main_measure.name: t of forecast coefficient in pooled regression of next-72-bar excess return on forecast and past 72-bar return (rising grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if coefficient > 0 with t >= 2; reject if coefficient < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 300 rising grid cases is not enough

decided_by: The forecast coefficient is positive with t >= 2 on at least 300 rising grid cases (confirm rule).
reading: Grid at positions 0,72,144,... of each window; rising cases need a past 72-bar close and a next-72-bar close inside the window; the coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean of the forward returns of all its grid bars over all windows; OLS with an intercept and the ordinary coefficient t.
